resolutions: Accepted Decision 0070 is now explicit in the plan's authority, task sequence, proof section, and Quality/Integration contracts: pre-Quality tasks record the unavailable new jobs as scheduled gaps; Quality creates them through a transport-only draft; final Quality and Integration require the actual results.

The later user instruction withdraws the draft-only Wait for all choice. The plan applies accepted Decision 0064: the addressed task and causal dependants pause, independently owned dependency-ready work continues, and coordinator transfer separately waits for required exchanges to finish or cancel.

First retains the already-authored coordinator-neutral canon, and every successor that changes an enduring boundary owns the matching WORKFLOW/FACTORY/QUALITY/ROLES/getting-started/architecture update in the same task and PR; task start remains workspace-first after the accepted first-task exception.

The amended plan defines Main as the one active Claude or Codex coordinator that schedules and records only authorized work. It explicitly cannot supply developer decisions, acceptance, sign-off, or approval; those remain human acts through their owning recorder.

The plan makes coordinator exclusion an explicit human-enforced operating rule rather than claiming a persisted fence: change only between completed tasks, after the old session stops and no worker or synchronous question remains; resume through forge next; add no live handoff, registry, token, or concurrent ownership.

The plan defines first-applicable-tier selection: one valid explicit argument, else one valid environment value, else exactly one detected host, else TTY. Higher tiers suppress lower disagreement; multiple explicit values, invalid selected input, cancellation, EOF, or missing TTY response refuse before repair.

The amended structured-call contract is atomic: every question must return one nonblank answer; cancellation, omission, or failure of any question records no eligible event and makes every partial answer from the call unusable.

Only ./forge grill run accepts --context-file. The fixed local allocation safeguard is 8,388,608 UTF-8 bytes; the installed component's limit must also be discoverable in UTF-8 bytes or the command refuses and names the unknown limit. Capacity includes the exact primary brief, delimiter, framing, and context bytes.

The plan rejects symlink or Windows reparse components at every ancestor and leaf, opens one no-follow/reparse-safe regular-file handle, requires pre-open/handle/post-read identity agreement, and launches one captured snapshot. Partition proof binds full-input SHA256, exact nonoverlapping ordered byte ranges, part count, helper/model identity, and aggregation version.

Portable holds the existing cross-platform exclusion lock across the whole migration, binds and revalidates the complete sorted inventory before every pointer commit, uses immutable generation plus per-task pointer-last commits, retains valid completed tasks on a later failure, and resumes only missing tasks on a byte-identical same-inventory retry; drift refuses before another commit.

The plan now mirrors the installed helper exactly: provider reports are authoritative; the synthesized list retains the first occurrence of the normalized path/line/category/tagged-title key in pass order, applies the exact chunk body prefix/bound, leaves later duplicates raw-only, and refuses mixed-source attribution. A real duplicate-across-chunks fixture is required.

The platform section names the exact six-row JSON shape, required local macOS CLI/Desktop and Ubuntu 24.04 x64/native Windows rows, tested revision and pinned Codex input, commands/interactions/logs, status derivation, permitted unobserved cells, and aggregate failure rules. Missing required rows or observed failures block.
